_meta.ptally/summary: Searches the documents uploaded to a project for the passages that answer a question, so answers about the product (what it covers, for one) can quote the source.
_meta.swallow/summary: Searches the documents uploaded to a project for the passages that answer a question, so answers about the product (what it covers, for one) can quote the source.

description: Search the documents uploaded to a project (policy wordings, product guides, underwriting guidelines or anything else) for the passages that answer a question about the product: what is covered or excluded, excesses, conditions, definitions, claims notice, eligibility. Takes `project_reference`, `query` (the question in plain words, or an exact term like "Section 4" or a defined term), optional `version_reference` (default: the latest live version, else the latest of any status; pass the version that priced a quote so the wording matches it), optional `k` (passages to return, default 5, max 20) and optional `document_references` to search only some documents. Every passage is scored by meaning (a local embedding model) and by keywords, blended 70/30. Returns `{ project_reference, version_reference, query, documents: { indexed, pending, failed }, results: [{ document_reference, title, filename, version_reference, chunk, page, section, text, score, similarity, keyword }], next_steps }`. `score` is relative to this search (the best passage scores near 1); `similarity` is the cosine similarity to the question (below about 0.5 is rarely relevant). Answer only from the returned text, citing title, section and page; read around a passage with get_doc. Nothing is changed.

document_references.description: Optional. Only search these documents (from get_project's or run_quote's documents).

k.description: Optional. How many passages to return, default 5, max 20.

project_reference.description: UUID of the project whose documents to search.

query.description: The question, in plain words (e.g. "is flood damage to a basement covered"), or an exact term to find (a clause number, a defined term).

version_reference.description: Optional. The version whose documents to search: documents for every version plus any pinned to this one. Defaults to the latest live version.
